desc: Design 2N-state shortest path model (vertex, orientation) with edge cost 1 and flip cost X.
Parse N, M, X, and the M directed edges into an adjacency list `adj` (1-indexed).
Initialize `dist = [[inf]*(N+1) for _ in range(2)]` and set `dist[0][1] = 0`.
Run Dijkstra with heap entries `(d, v, p)`; on each pop, relax moves to neighbors in same parity (cost 1) and flip to opposite parity (cost X).
